What does an AI Due Diligence cover and what does it cost?

AI Due Diligence from Dave Willemstein is a technically grounded assessment of an AI proposition or vendor, for investors and for organizations buying AI. The result is a DD report with an explicit verdict and a red-flag overview, built on four parallel research tracks. The engagement takes 2-4 weeks and is priced as a fixed project fee, set out in the proposal, excluding VAT and travel expenses; the engagement always happens under NDA.
Does an AI Due Diligence always happen under NDA?
AI Due Diligence always happens under NDA, both toward the client and toward the target.
What determines the price of an AI Due Diligence?
AI Due Diligence is priced as a fixed project fee, depending on scope: assessing one solution asks less than an entire company.
Source: Dave Willemstein's rates and typical timelines. Updated: October 2026.
